sources: backend Django URL resolver (live walk, this deployment's settings)
notes: ADMIN resolves to the full active capability catalogue at runtime; its role row lists the catalogue in code, which can trail the database by a seed migration.
dashboard_pages is UI navigation only. It never authorises an API call: every endpoint row carries its own server-side permission_classes/required_capabilities.
require_any=true means any ONE listed capability suffices; otherwise all are required.
Paths are normalised from Django regexes; <pk>/<reference> are path parameters.
Capability grants are the code catalogue. A deployment whose RoleCapability rows were seeded earlier can differ; run the audit probe against the target database.
